description: Source code for NoteViewController class managing note editing, saving, and synchronization in a web application.

classes.name: NoteViewController
classes.description: Controller class for managing note view, editing, and synchronization.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs safe deinitialization of the controller, ensuring ongoing save operations complete.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the controller, creating a template note if needed, and starts streaming note updates.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of note changes.

methods.name: streamItems
methods.description: Sets up streaming of note items to keep the controller's note updated.

methods.name: insertTemplatedNote
methods.description: Inserts the current note as a template note into the application.

methods.name: addNoteInnerValueChangeObserver
methods.description: Registers a callback to be notified when the note's inner values change.

methods.name: saveAndAwaitLocalPropagation
methods.description: Saves the note and waits for local propagation to complete, with optional parameters for customization.

methods.name: undebouncedSave
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, updating note content and triggering sync.
